  • Ceasefire / Diplomacy: Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET). Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

  • Domestic / Security Incidents: Man shot dead near northern Arab town of Kabul (suspected homicide). DOJ opened probe into a NYC coffee chain after it barred a pro-Israel US lawmaker. A US-Israeli suspect was extradited to Florida on 2016–17 threat charges.
